thread:
sanjay: Heads-up: we're targeting a base-image rebuild with KMS rotation next Thu 02:00 UTC. Main constraint: some HSM keys can't be called from user binaries. Proposing ephemeral signing helper to bridge cosign -> KMS. Need RBAC split, audit field requirements, and a short rollback playbook. cc @neha @arthur
neha: RBAC plan: 1) builder SA = build/push only; no access to secrets or KMS. 2) signer SA = allowed to call KMS:Sign on specific key versions only. 3) helper SA = TTL 1h token, annotated audited=true. Also add OPA gate to prevent builder->signer bindings.
sanjay: Audit: helper and cosign must emit structured JSON: ["op","key_id","signer_principal","pod_uid","image_digest","result"] route to index "images.audit" with 365d retention in prod, 90d staging.
arthur: Network/security: helper must run in isolated signing subnet with egress-only to KMS endpoints. NodeAffinity to signing nodes and taint/toleration to limit scheduling.
ops-bot: preflight: found missing registry-protection rule -> recommend protect last 30 signed tags per base image and set immutability 72h post-rotation
neha: Rollback (concise): 1) stop new deploys, 2) promote previous signed tags, 3) revert to previous KMS key version, 4) run cosign-verify across clusters, 5) resume after green. Owner: Sanjay (primary), Arthur (backup).
kms-bot: recommend IAM condition: request.time < timestamp("2026-07-01T04:00:00Z") && source.ip in ["10.0.5.0/24"] for signer binding
sanjay: I'll open PR with RBAC + OPA webhook + helper manifest. Schedule dry-run in staging first. Post blockers here. :thumbsup:
